name: Cincinnati
description: Cincinnati is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest five-card poker hand, formed from any combination of your five hole cards and the five community cards.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: five cards face down to each player and five face down to the table. 2. Players look at their hands. 3. Dealer turns the table cards face up one at a time; after each card is turned there is a round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold). 4. After the fifth and final betting round, showdown: each active player's hand is the best five-card hand from any combination of their hole cards and the five table cards. 5. Highest hand wins the pot.
keyRules: Each player has five hole cards; five community cards are revealed one by one with a betting round after each.
Best five-card hand uses any combination of the player's five hole cards and the five community cards.
Standard poker hand rankings determine the winner; standard betting order applies (e.g. check, bet, call, raise, fold).

strategy.basic: Cincinnati: follow rules; strategy depends on variant.
strategy.intermediate: Track revealed information (cards, tiles, tricks, or betting patterns) and adjust plan as opponent ranges narrow.
strategy.advanced: Use tempo and denial lines to convert small positional edges into scoring swings in late hand phases.
tips: Fix the exact local variant before play so edge cases are predictable.
Plan two turns ahead: most mistakes come from giving opponents forced value.
Recalculate risk near end-of-hand scoring thresholds.

variations.name: High card of suit splits pot
variations.description: Holder of the highest card of the suit of a particular table card (often the last or third turned) splits the pot with the highest hand. Alternatively: high hand splits with holder of highest card of that suit if table card is 8 or higher, or with lowest card of the suit if 7 or lower.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes pot-split and wild rules; no engine constant overrides needed.

variations.name: Last table card wild
variations.description: The last table card turned over and all cards of the same rank are wild.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes wild cards; no engine constant overrides needed.

variations.name: Low Hole Cincinnati
variations.description: Each player's lowest hole card is wild for that player, along with any others of the same rank.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes wild cards per player; no engine constant overrides needed.

scoring.description: Pot is won by the highest five-card hand at showdown; no point target.
scoring.winCondition: Highest five-card hand using any combination of hole cards and the five community cards wins the pot.
